summary: The settings framework combines structural-context caching, a strict validate_assignment invariant, a structural/runtime parameter split, dynamic Pydantic field installation for connection profiles, and secret resolution. Cached retrieval pins source state but materializes each complete invocation as an independently owned result.

concepts.name: Structural-context caching architecture
concepts.description: A private SettingsManager context captures selected source inputs by five-field structural identity. Each retrieval validates the complete invocation and installs an owned result graph, so runtime values and mutable caller state never enter retained baseline state. Source refresh remains separate lifecycle work.

concepts.name: SettingsParameters structural/runtime split
concepts.description: Custom __hash__ and __eq__ on SettingsParameters include the five structural selectors, making them suitable for context lookup. Runtime inputs validate per invocation rather than becoming a cached overlay. The merge() method uses field-specific strategies: union for file lists, last-wins for scalars, and deep-merge for dictionaries.

concepts.name: validate_assignment=True and object.__setattr__ invariant
concepts.description: All attribute assignment triggers Pydantic validation, including SecretStr wrapping, enum coercion, and AfterValidator hooks. Internal metadata fields (SETTINGS_SOURCE_*) use object.__setattr__ to bypass revalidation and avoid polluting model_fields_set. This pattern is documented in the setattr-bypass-fix design spec.

concepts.name: DescriptorProfile dynamic field installation
concepts.description: __pydantic_init_subclass__ fires at class creation time and installs fields from the profile descriptor into model_fields and __annotations__. A model_rebuild(force=True) call finalises the updated schema. The auth discriminated union is assembled dynamically from the descriptor's auth_modes list.

concepts.name: Secrets resolution pipeline
concepts.description: Resolution runs in two passes during __init__: accepted kwargs are first captured privately in source form and a working copy is resolved via resolve_references_in_dict before super().__init__; loaded config fields are then resolved via resolve_references_in_model_tree after construction. Nested BaseModel fields are rebuilt as fresh instances to respect the frozen=True constraint.

concepts.name: Config file dispatch pipeline
concepts.description: Files are separated by extension into categorised groups (env, YAML, TOML, JSON). The appropriate file path is set on model_config before calling super().__init__(). settings_customise_sources() returns the source priority tuple that Pydantic uses to layer values.

concepts.name: Concurrency and evolution considerations
concepts.description: Per-context initialization coordinates source capture while callbacks and copies run outside broad manager locks. Dynamic field installation via model_rebuild() should be verified after Pydantic version upgrades. Profile origin/template integration, direct-constructor source framing, common errors, and lifecycle refresh remain separately sequenced work.
